entities.summary: Skay Beilinson (b. 1952-01-15, La Plata) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in La Plata and Argentina. Known in the fields of argentina, composers & musicians, americas.
